apps.name: Ksign
apps.subtitle: ESign-style app signer
apps.localizedDescription: Ksign is a community “cleaner” take on ESign — an iOS app signer and installer. Import IPA files, sign them with your own certificate and install them on device, with Feather-based app-icon styles.
apps.versionDescription:
Ksign 1.6 | Ksign

Hawoo everywan its been half a year since the last release I'm really sorry because ever since beta build I got lazy from release a new version, anyways 

## What's Changed
* fix: handle empty display name in info.plist
* fix: url scheme for ksign
* fix: signing on a few apps with weird bundles
* feat: injection path & inject into extensions
* feat: optimized for iOS 26 by @Nyasami in https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign/pull/87
* feat: bulk install by @Nyasami in https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign/pull/88
* feat: idevice installation method by @Nyasami in https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign/pull/96
* feat: Add support for .bundle files as tweaks (copy into .app) by @Mikasa-san in https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign/pull/112
* chore: update language: German, Russian by @MrCookie-For-Programmers in https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign/pull/105
* chore: update Arabic translation by @mohammed1d1 in https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign/pull/108
* chore: update Vietnamese localizations by @Astear17 in https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign/pull/109
* feat: rsd support by @claration in https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign/pull/117

## New Contributors
* @MrCookie-For-Programmers made their first contribution in https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign/pull/76
* @mohammed1d1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign/pull/108
* @Mikasa-san made their first contribution in https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign/pull/112
* @Astear17 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign/pull/109
* @claration made their first contribution in https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign/pull/117

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Nyasami/Ksign/compare/v1.5.1...v1.6
